title: Leave Policy
content: Employees are entitled to 20 days annual leave, 10 days sick leave, and 5 personal days per year. Leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least 2 weeks in advance for planned leave. Emergency leave can be reported to your manager directly.

title: Remote Work Policy
content: The company follows a hybrid work model: 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday), 2 days remote (Monday, Friday). Fully remote arrangements require VP approval and are subject to role suitability assessment.

title: Expense Policy
content: Expenses under $100 require manager approval. Expenses over $100 require director approval. All expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the expense. Receipts are required for all expenses over $25.

title: Onboarding Checklist
content: Day 1: IT setup (laptop, accounts), badge collection, welcome kit. Week 1: Team introductions, mandatory training sessions, role-specific onboarding. Month 1: Performance goals setup, mentor assignment.

title: Refund Policy
content: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Electronics have a 15-day return window. Items must be in original packaging. Custom orders are non-refundable. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

title: Security Policy
content: All employees must complete annual security training. Passwords must be changed every 90 days. Multi-factor authentication is required for all systems. Report security incidents immediately to the Security team.
